title: Lucid Dreams in Mall World?
content: There have been multiple dreams in my Mall World where I am lucid and can roam. When I visit whatever time period in Hawaii things are bizarre but I'm fully aware. There's almost always some kind of Tribal/Native American ceremony for my Dad that I'm a part of. Many times just jumped in the ocean and can breathe underwater with no threat of being attacked by anything... Does anyone lucid dream like this? Does anyone have lucid dreams about the train stations but not being able to speak the language? Just looking to see if there are any similarities. Thank you.
